messages:
maya: quick heads-up — trying to pull site-level model latency + KV cache hitrate across APAC/EU but the grafana dashboard 'site-model-health' 403s for me. anyone can share the shortlink or grant view? also seeing the model-health-high-latency alert flapping in apac, thinking threshold might be too tight. pinging eng-platform/eng-sre for perm + alert tuning :wave:

jon: shortlink is https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/8f7a2/site-model-health?orgId=1&var-region=apac — should work if you have the grafana-viewers role. try incognito if you recently got added.

maya: opened link, still 403. it says "You do not have permission to view this dashboard". I'm signed in via SSO.

alex: we flipped group sync last week. if your SSO account isn't mapped into the eng-ml-viewers group you'll hit 403. send me your account id and I'll check.

maya: maya@redwood.ai

alex: added maya to eng-ml-viewers. group sync runs every 5m but can be triggered manually. try again in a few.

maya: access works now, thanks! found the latency-by-site panel. on the alert side: APAC rule fires ~6x/day on short 1.5–2s bursts (p95) — looks like tail noise. proposal: increase rolling window to 5m and bump p95 threshold from 400ms -> 600ms. thoughts?

sophie: +1. infra sees short GC/heavy-batch artifacts in APAC too. those bursts don't correlate with error rate.

samir: cautious: relaxing threshold hides regressions. alternative: require 2 consecutive windows or add a count threshold (e.g., >3 high-p95 events in 10m) so single spikes don't fire. happy to draft PR.

jon: runbook link: https://go.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-latency — prefer change with runbook + test. samir, if you send a terraform-alerts PR I can review.

ben-sre-bot: Alert change request created by samir: https://infra.redwood.ai/changes/CH-9876 — awaiting approval and review by SRE.

maya: ran a quick promql check to sanity: `increase(request_duration_seconds_sum{job="infer",region="apac"}[5m]) / increase(request_duration_seconds_count{job="infer",region="apac"}[5m])` — shows the short spikes align with what grafana panel shows. attaching a snapshot to CH-9876.

alex: nice. if anyone else lacks access DM me or file at #help-permissions. i'll follow up with grafana team if group sync needs manual bump. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
